item.title: 4 Killed in Oro landslide amid Tropical Storm Basyang
item.description: Four people were killed after a landslide struck Zone 1, Barangay Sambulawan, Barangay Agusan here during the onslaught of Tropical Storm Basyang, authorities confirmed. The landslide occurred at around 10:30 p.m. following hours of continuous heavy rainfall. item.title: As ‘Basyang’ hits Mindanao: Road to Claveria resorts shut, Oro halts work
item.description: AUTHORITIES closed a major road link famous for its mountain resorts in Claveria, Misamis Oriental, as Tropical Storm Basyang (international name: Penha) moved closer to Mindanao on Thursday.
